name: @funcd/example-log-burst
description: A funcd log-capture example (ADR-0081, Path B): a function whose handler emits a burst of ≥100 console.* logs (a mix of log/warn/error, structured) per invocation. Authored in TypeScript against @funcd/shim-nodejs; build.ts bundles it to burst.mjs. The Lima e2e deploys it to prove ≥100 function logs are captured channel-only by the runtime-shim console producer.
